interpretation: Exploratory chronological replay on previously examined historical data. Current complete rosters and scores precede prediction; exits are released after prediction. Only eligible single ordinary exits update mixture weights. No independent prospective validation or observed true audience votes. Seasons 1-2 and the judge-save regime from season 28 are outside this study. Bootstrap intervals condition on fixed predictions and exclude fitting, selection and repeated historical exploration uncertainty.
result_scope: Historical findings require paired assessment and independent future validation.
